provenance.generated_by: drivers/mice/generate_scaling.py on pystatsval, against a PyPI install of pystatistics==3.18.0
provenance.note: First HARNESS-GENERATED mice artifact (not a bootstrap snapshot). Numeric scaling study, synthetic seeded DGP (make_complete + impose_mcar, seed 20260617), generated by drivers/mice/generate_scaling.py against PyPI pystatistics 3.18.0 on TWO hosts: CPU+MPS on the Mac, CPU+CUDA on Forge (throwaway cloned env, cleaned up after; standing CUDA-testing allowance). This report covers the scaling study only; the other mice studies (fidelity vs R, Rubin coverage, categorical, vs-miceforest) remain at the 3.16.3 headline (bootstrap) until ported to native generators.

reference.what: The CRAN mice package (van Buuren & Groothuis-Oudshoorn) — multiple imputation by chained equations. The scaling study measures pystatistics CPU-vs-accelerator speed; head-to-head fidelity vs R is part of the (not-yet-regenerated-at-3.18.0) fidelity study.
